_about: Embraer 175 with the enhanced wingtip, from APM 2259 Rev 22 Figure 2.2 (page index 18): side, plan and front views on one sheet. Its views aren't drawn to one scale both ways: across, the side and plan are squeezed to 0.969 of their height scale and the front stretched to 1.032 (the printed 31.68 m length and 9.86 m height; the 28.65 m span and 4.88 m tip height), so layers.py --xscale evens each out. Pixels of those rasters at scale 16, line centres.

sources.title: Embraer, Embraer 175 Airport Planning Manual (APM 2259 Rev 22, Nov 29/24), Section 02, Figure 2.2 General Aircraft Dimensions (enhanced wingtip)
sources.note: Read from the Internet Archive's copy of 2025-07-19 (web.archive.org/web/20250719232738/...): Embraer's link now redirects to a missing page. Dimensions and outlines read off the side, plan and front views (tools/trace/e75l/); the figures are the aircraft's measurements, not a copy of the drawing. The figure's views are squeezed across by a few percent, each by its own amount; each is evened out from its printed dimensions before tracing, so confidence is medium.
